$description: Fit and overflow (platform/standards/fit-and-overflow.md; owner, 2026-10-29): the values every adaptation shares. A heading or label wraps to evenly balanced lines, at most --plx-sys-fit-lines, in the line height --plx-sys-fit-line-height, with --plx-sys-fit-wrap-padding-block above and below, so one line keeps its control height and two lines are 40px, all on the 4px grid. The container widths are the breakpoints a container query uses (CSS cannot read a token there: each query writes the same value beside its comment).

fit-lines.$description: The most lines a wrapping heading or label shows; past them the last line ends in an ellipsis and the full text is in a tooltip.

fit-line-height.$description: The line height of a wrapping heading or label: two lines are 32px; with the padding below, 40px.

fit-footer-stack-width.$description: A footer or an action bar stacks its main button and Cancel full width, the main one first, in a window narrower than this (the window, not the bar). The media query writes the same 400px (CSS cannot read a token there); a component reads this token.

fit-wrap-padding-block.$description: The room above and below the lines of a wrapping heading: a one-line heading stays at its control height (32px), two lines become 40px.
